name: Margaret 'Maggie' O'Reilly
household: Partner (55), adult daughter (23) living at home during gaps in university
psychographics: Prioritises community connection and tactile experience; believes a physical bookstore is a cultural anchor in a digital world.
current_solutions: Uses Square for payments and till operations; manages staff rosters on Google Calendar; relies on Instagram for daily specials.
frustration: Had to manually reconcile the till drawer at 11:30 PM last Friday after a rush; the Square sync lagged, forcing her to count coins by hand for 45 minutes while the shop was closed to the public.
decision_style: Prefers to test POS systems in person during quiet hours; often asks other local retailers for recommendations before switching from her trusted Square setup.
voice: Rambling but warm; frequently pauses to look at books or gesturing at the café counter. Uses Irish slang like 'deadly' and 'grand' but switches to formal register when discussing finances.
